name: Quang Ninh Integrated Data Center (Trung tâm Tích hợp Dữ liệu tỉnh Quảng Ninh)
developer: Quang Ninh provincial authorities / Quang Ninh ICT Center (QNICT)
notes: Provincial newspaper reports Quang Ninh actively deploying its digital-infrastructure plan including data center development; QNICT (provincial ICT center) page describes 24/7 management and operation of the integrated data center; VietNamNet covers security management of the Quang Ninh data center. Public-sector scale, no commercial MW disclosed.

name: Cao Bang Provincial Data Center (Trung tâm dữ liệu tỉnh Cao Bằng)
notes: VietNamNet reports the Cao Bang provincial data center operates under a password/access management regulation covering access control, backup/recovery and system security; publication date of source not shown, recorded as date checked. No capacity disclosed.

name: Son La Integrated Data Center (Trung tâm tích hợp dữ liệu Sơn La)
developer: Son La provincial authorities / ICT and Communications Center of Son La
notes: State procurement notice shows approval of bidding for firewall equipment to upgrade the Son La integrated data center (state-budget funded), run by the ICT and Communications Center under the provincial People's Committee; provincial ICT department site also references the center. Public-sector scale, no MW disclosed.

name: Lang Son Integrated Data Center (Trung tâm tích hợp dữ liệu tỉnh Lạng Sơn)
developer: Lang Son provincial authorities / Department of Information and Communications
notes: Aggregated articles from the provincial press describe ICT staff inspecting equipment at the Lang Son integrated data center and the provincial LGSP data-integration platform connected to 44 central/local systems; original Baolangson pages not verified directly, so graded C. No capacity disclosed.

name: Lao Cai Provincial Data Center / Integrated Data Center development (Trung tâm dữ liệu tỉnh Lào Cai)
notes: VOV (state broadcaster) reports Lao Cai focusing on its provincial data strategy, including developing an integrated data center, to 2030 as part of digital government/smart-city pillars; secondary mirror (fireant) repeats the plan. Status kept planned as sources describe strategy/development rather than commissioning. No MW disclosed.
